g.text: bsp-tex-flags-gui
A Tkinter window that decodes the texture lump of a Soldier of Fortune
.bsp
and prints the surface flags compiled into each texture.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`python dump_tex_lump.py` · must run from the repo root, it loads `sof1r.ppm` and `sof1g.ppm` by relative path
type a search term · `*` for every texture, otherwise a substring of the name
click the button · only green once a term is typed, then opens the file dialog
`make_exe.py` · cx_Freeze recipe, frozen outputs already in `build/` and `bsp_tex_flags_gui.7z`
read the file · whole `.bsp` into memory, no size check
find lump 5 · 8-byte header then 8-byte entries of offset and size, `struct.unpack_from`
walk 76-byte `texinfo` records · flags at +32, value at +36, 32-byte latin-1 name at +40
match against `SURF_FLAGS` · bitwise AND per entry, insertion order is the print order
print · name line, one line per set flag, the value line for `light` and `animspeed`
nothing persisted · no config, no history, no output file
`SURF_FLAGS` · 20 names and masks hardcoded in the script, `material` = `0xFF000000`
`.bsp` map files · SoF v46 layout, dumped by whatever compiler made them
Tk and ttk · `clam` theme, one scrollable text widget
cx_Freeze · `build/exe.win-amd64-3.9`, `build/exe.linux-x86_64-3.9`
the offset points into the same buffer
a memoryview slice, never copied
every record, matched or not
`needle in name` or `needle == "*"` decides what is printed
term and file path are the only inputs
reads the table, writes nothing
reads a map, draws into Tk
